propositions: Bridge provider matrix test fails on macOS dev hosts with ambient git config injection (GIT_CONFIG_COUNT/KEY_*/VALUE_*) but passes in CI due to inherited os.environ in git()/bare_git() helpers
Hostile ambient config (safe.bareRepository=explicit) causes 'git -C <bare-repo> show' to fail with 'cannot use bare repository' in verification calls within the harness
Test harness helpers do not scrub command-scope git config environment variables before invoking git subprocesses, allowing host-specific injection to break test isolation
Unsetting GIT_CONFIG_* env vars makes all 5 matrix parameters pass on the same dev host tree, proving the root cause

Fix requires scrubbing GIT_CONFIG_COUNT/KEY_*/VALUE_*/PARAMETERS in harness helpers and runner_env, pinning GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null and GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1, and monkeypatching hostile injection into the matrix test for deterministic CI regression coverage
